en.summary: This commit fixes L2 directory flush sequencing so the flush walker advances only when its current result is actually consumed, instead of running ahead under backpressure.
why_it_counts: Directory_test.scala is an implementation module under src/L2cache, not a standalone test script.
The patch changes the directory flush counter and flush-result semantics inside active cache-control logic.
Advancing a maintenance walker without a completed handshake is a real correctness bug.
evidence: flushCount increments change from io.flush || io.invalidate || flush_issue_reg to io.flush || io.invalidate || (flush_issue_reg && io.result.fire).
The flush-path hit bit stops being forced to true and instead uses the normal hit expression.
Both changes are inside Directory_test.scala, which contains the directory state arrays and flush walk.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache directory flush walker scans set and way entries and may emit per-line results to downstream logic. The walker must not advance to the next entry until the current line's result has actually completed its handshake. If the counter advances merely because flush mode is active, backpressure can cause entries to be skipped or completion bookkeeping to get out of sync with real work.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Flush or invalidate is active and the consumer of directory results is not ready every cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Advance the flush counter based on local issue state instead of on successful result consumption.
portability_notes: This applies to any cache tag or directory walker that emits line-level maintenance work to another stage.
If some lines do not generate outputs, only the lines that truly produce work should depend on a handshake; do not globally drop the completion guard.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the counter or pointer that steps through sets and ways during flush or invalidate.
Remove the dependency on the downstream result fire or equivalent completion pulse, making the walker advance whenever the local flush state is active.
Optionally keep the rest of the walker unchanged so the injected bug specifically tests progress under backpressure.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory flushCount advancement and flush-result status
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit makes flushCount advance only on io.result.fire while flush_issue_reg is active and also stops hardcoding flush results as hits.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In Directory_test.scala, the flushCount update changed to include flush_issue_reg && io.result.fire, and the flush-path io.result.bits.hit assignment stopped forcing true.B.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under backpressure, the directory can skip lines, finish early, or report misleading flush status, which can leave stale directory state or incomplete maintenance.
evidence_for_injection: The changed condition directly controls the flush walker counter.
The file is the real directory implementation and includes status_reg plus flush traversal state.
The patch also fixes flush response semantics, reinforcing that the bug is in active maintenance behavior.
notes: The progress-handshake bug is the most portable mutation from this small commit.
Reintroducing the forced hit=true behavior is possible but less generally useful than the counter bug.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 directory 的 flush 时序，使 flush walker 只有在当前结果真正被消费后才前进，而不会在存在背压时自行跑到下一项。
why_it_counts: Directory_test.scala 位于 src/L2cache 下，是实现模块，不是独立测试脚本。
补丁修改的是 directory 内部的 flush 计数与 flush 结果语义，属于实际 cache 控制逻辑。
在维护遍历中不等待握手完成就前进，是明确的正确性错误。
evidence: flushCount 的推进条件从 io.flush || io.invalidate || flush_issue_reg 改成了 io.flush || io.invalidate || (flush_issue_reg && io.result.fire)。
flush 路径上的 hit 位不再被强制写成 true，而是改为正常 hit 表达式。
这两个修改都位于包含 directory 状态数组和 flush 遍历逻辑的 Directory_test.scala。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: cache directory 的 flush walker 会按 set/way 顺序扫描条目，并可能向下游发出逐行维护结果。只有当前条目的结果真正完成握手后，walker 才应该前进。如果仅仅因为本地处于 flush 状态就推进计数器，那么在下游有背压时就可能跳过条目，或者让完成状态与真实完成工作脱节。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: directory 维护遍历在背压下的推进控制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 或 invalidate 激活，并且 directory 结果的消费者不是每个周期都 ready。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 flush 计数器依赖本地 issue 状态推进，而不是依赖结果成功被消费。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何会把逐行维护工作发往另一阶段的 cache tag 或 directory walker。
如果某些条目本来就不产生输出，只有真正需要输出的条目才应依赖握手；不要粗暴地删掉所有完成保护。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 flush 或 invalidate 时遍历 set/way 的计数器或指针。
移除对下游 result.fire 或等价完成脉冲的依赖，使 walker 只要本地 flush 状态有效就持续前进。
其余 walker 逻辑保持不变，从而把注入故障集中在“背压下推进错误”这一点上。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory 的 flushCount 推进与 flush 结果状态
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交让 flushCount 只在 flush_issue_reg 有效且 io.result.fire 时推进，并且不再把 flush 结果硬编码成命中。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 Directory_test.scala 中，flushCount 更新条件被改成包含 flush_issue_reg && io.result.fire；同时 flush 路径上的 io.result.bits.hit 不再固定为 true.B。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在有背压时，directory 可能跳过条目、过早结束 flush，或给出误导性的 flush 状态，最终留下陈旧目录状态或不完整的维护结果。
evidence_for_injection: 被修改的条件直接控制 flush walker 的计数器推进。
该文件就是实际的 directory 实现，包含 status_reg 和 flush 遍历状态。
补丁同时修复了 flush 结果语义，进一步说明问题位于真实维护行为。
notes: 这个小提交里，最具可移植性的回注点是“推进必须等结果握手完成”的错误。
把 hit=true 的旧行为也回退可以作为次要变异点，但通用性不如计数器错误。
